```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

Purpose: re-run the curated cell-type marker gene `FeaturePlot`s from
`05-curated_cell_type_marker_genes.Rmd` on the final object
(`final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds`), rather than the pre-final-clustering
object those plots were originally made from. Only the 5 cell types retained
in the final object are plotted here (Mesenchyme, Myocardium, Endocardium,
VSMC, Epicardium) - Macrophage, RBC and Platelet markers are dropped since
those populations were filtered out and aren't present in this object.

# Clean-up environment

```{r}
rm(list = ls(all.names = TRUE)) # will clear all objects includuing hidden objects
gc() # free up memory and report the memory usage
options(max.print = .Machine$integer.max,
        scipen = 999,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
        dplyr.summarise.inform = FALSE) # Print everything without truncation, avoid scientific notation, keep strings as characters, silence dplyr’s “grouped output” informational messages
set.seed(42) # set seed for reproducibility
```

# Load Libraries

```{r}
# Core tidyverse
library(tidyverse)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# Single Cell
library(Seurat) # Seurat (relies on dplyr/tidyr, so load after tidyverse)

# additional plotting functions
library(patchwork)
```

# User defined functions

```{r}
# Helper function (put this at the top of your script)
save_if <- function(plot_object, filename, width, height, ...) {
  if (save_plots) {
    ggsave(plot = plot_object,
           filename = filename,
           width = width,
           height = height,
           dpi = 300)
  }
}
# change to TRUE to save plots
save_plots <- TRUE

```

# Set project directories and file paths

```{r}
project_name <- "20251104_sophieWiszniak_ncc_pa"

base_repo_dir <- "/home/melanie-smith/workDir/sophieWiszniak"
project_repo_dir <- file.path(base_repo_dir, project_name)
out_dir <- file.path(project_repo_dir, "outDir")

data_dir <- file.path(out_dir, "06-cluster_marker_genes")
new_out_dir <- file.path(data_dir, "curated_marker_genes")

if (!dir.exists(new_out_dir)) {
  dir.create(new_out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

# Load required objects
- Final object: post-QC, post-filtering, 5 retained cell types (Mesenchyme,
  Myocardium, Endocardium, VSMC, Epicardium), clustered at resolution 0.6.

```{r}
final_interesting_cells_0.6 <- readRDS(file = file.path(data_dir, "final_interesting_cells_0.6.rds"))
stopifnot(inherits(final_interesting_cells_0.6, "Seurat"))

table(final_interesting_cells_0.6$new_celltypes)
```

## Plot cell-type marker genes
nb: The marker genes used here are from [Single-cell RNA-Seq of the developing cardiac outflow tract reveals convergent development of the vascular smooth muscle cells](https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S2211124719308721?via%3Dihub#fig5)

- Epicardial lineage

```{r}
epicardial_markers <- FeaturePlot(
  object = final_interesting_cells_0.6,
  features = c("Upk3b", "Upk1b"),
  ncol = 2,                      # side-by-side panels
  order = TRUE                   # high-expression cells on top
  ) &
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),
    name = "Expression"
  ) &
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Epicardial lineage markers",
    caption = "Final object: 5 retained cell types, cluster resolution 0.6"
  ) &
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
save_if(epicardial_markers,
       filename = file.path(new_out_dir, "06-umap.epicardial_genes.png"),
       width = 16,
       height = 8)
```

## Four-panel core marker FeaturePlots

- Core 4-gene marker set per cell type, read directly from the dot plot on
  slide 7 of the lab meeting deck (`outDir/16-lab_meeting_deck/`) - no
  equivalent list exists as a reusable variable anywhere in the codebase, so
  this is transcribed from that figure.

- Myocardium

```{r}
myocardium_4marker <- FeaturePlot(
  object = final_interesting_cells_0.6,
  features = c("Myh7", "Myl4", "Ttn", "Pln"),
  ncol = 2,
  order = TRUE
  ) &
  scale_colour_gradientn(
    colours = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(11, "Spectral")),
    name = "Expression"
  ) &
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Myocardium core markers",
    caption = "Final object: 5 retained cell types, cluster resolution 0.6"
  ) &
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) &
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )
save_if(myocardium_4marker,
       filename = file.path(new_out_dir, "06-umap.myocardium_4marker_genes.png"),
       width = 12,
       height = 10)
```
